rdkit_descriptors.selection: all descriptors finite across all 7608 ML-ready structures, sorted by name

loss_nuisance.scaling: same StandardScaler fit on all rows of each nuisance-training fold; Ridge fit only on observed training rows

mask_generation.mcar_probability: actual-mask observed fraction within the corresponding truth cohort
mask_generation.mar_probability: clipped five-fold scaffold-grouped OOF anchor probability restricted to the truth cohort
mask_generation.sampling: independent Bernoulli draws; do not force an exact observed count
mask_generation.mnar_z: truth-cohort population mean and population SD (ddof=0)
mask_generation.mnar_recenter: solve one intercept per truth endpoint x anchor x gamma so mean probability equals mean clipped MAR anchor probability

gate_6_aggregation.rows: 2 truth endpoints x 3 MAR anchors x 40 seeds x 2 primary models = 480 equally weighted rows
gate_6_aggregation.coverage: proportion of the same 480 AIPW 95% intervals containing truth
gate_6_aggregation.ess_acceptance: all 480 rows must have ESS / observed_n >= 0.25; retain every row in descriptive arithmetic

gate_5_aggregation.actual_settings: 2 truth endpoints x 5 empirical masks; any setting triggers by max model relative absolute CC bias >= 0.05 or a strict two-model winner change
gate_5_aggregation.mar_settings: 2 truth endpoints x 3 anchors; each setting aggregates all 40 seeds
gate_5_aggregation.mar_rank: at least 21 of 40 CC winners differ from the full-truth winner
gate_5_aggregation.tie_rule: full-truth exact tie makes ranking non-adjudicative; complete-case exact tie is not a change
